title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020), multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for the long cooperation under ctr:4600070620.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

In our meeting of 27 June you explained that multi-year volume agreements are what changes prices. We are therefore offering a multi-year commitment of 20,000 pieces per year over 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached term sheets. This gives you a fixed volume and less order-handling work on a standard stock item.

Which of these packages works best for you? And could you confirm your earliest lead time from stock?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020), multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposal and the prospect of a 24-month commitment. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our present offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We can offer €4.88 for a 24-month agreement with 30-day payment terms, and our team will separately confirm the lead times from stock. 

Our offer is valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – volume commitment and revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer.

To answer your question on volume, we can commit to 20,000 pieces per year for 24 months, or 20,000 pieces per year for 36 months. The attached term sheets set this out. The 36-month option secures the business for an additional year and removes a further renewal round for both sides.

We have moved a clear step towards you. We also kept your 30-day payment option for your cash flow.

In June your owner offered to walk us through your calculation. We would welcome a pricing review with him on these packages.

Which package can you sign?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – volume commitment and revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our extensive range and service. We truly appreciate your commitment to 20,000 pieces per year over 24 months. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide based on our quote, which reflects a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Also, which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We are open to scheduling a pricing review meeting with our owner once we have reached a closer alignment on these terms. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
